reason: This PR is small-to-medium in size but concentrated in core planner/statistics code, and it appears to change how column IDs are threaded into stats-loading and selectivity/cardinality logic. The touched paths are central optimizer surfaces (`cardinality/*`, `core/stats.go`, `statistics/table.go`) rather than an isolated leaf fix, so a bad assumption here could silently distort row-count estimates and plan selection across many queries. That is exactly the kind of optimizer/statistics behavior that can hide High-severity regressions, so it clears the bar for a focused deep review.
